controls: Click a part in the preview
Click the face outside any part
Corner resize handles (nw, ne, sw, se) drag; scale = start scale x distance-from-centre ratio, clamped to capability min/max; live preview local; sent on pointer up if changed
Delete or Backspace on the preview
Select "Composition base" (presets of the current kind)
Select "Selection" (Choose an object, Whole avatar, slots with variants)
Number "Scale" (min/max from capabilities, out-of-range rejected locally)
Select "Feature <property>" (one per feature property of the slot)
Chooser: one button per shape kind (enum of drawing.object.make.kind)
Chooser: "Add from knowledge" button or Enter in the search
Ctrl/Cmd/Shift-click, or tap in "Select multiple" mode
Drag an object (threshold 3 px mouse, 8 px touch); live preview local
Resize handles (8: nw, n, ne, e, se, s, sw, w) on the selection bounds
Box select: drag on empty space (a click on empty space is an empty box)
Phone properties sheet: a tap selection on a stacked (narrow) layout opens the inspector as a bottom sheet with "Close"
Select "Named colour" (Original colours, Custom (disabled), colour names)
Select "Group member" (members, or back to the parent group)
Inspector: "Part look" (the variants of a look part's slot: a person's hair, hat, clothes; eyes on the sun)
Inspector: "Part shape" (basic shapes and the k.layouts outlines: irregular, star, heart)
Inspector: "Add part" text and button (a part by its word: hat, t-shirt, eyes, chimney)
Inspector: "Emotion" (k.faces expressions) and "Traits: <age>, <sex>" (observed inputs age, sex)
Inspector: "Pose", "Trait", "Wear" (options pose, trait, garment) and "Hold" (a kind)
Chooser: shape buttons (rectangle, circle, ellipse, square, diamond, triangle, hexagon, star, text)
Add mode: tap or click the canvas
Toggle "Connect": tap source node, then destination node
Phone touch on the board; properties sheet
Shift/Ctrl/Cmd-click a node, or tap in multi mode
Click a connection (plain or with modifier)
Click a group frame or label
Drag a node (threshold 4 px mouse, 8 px touch); live preview local
Drag a group frame, or a member of the selected group
Resize handle (bottom-right square per selected node) drag; symmetric, 8 to 4096; circle/square/sector uniform
Box select: drag on empty canvas
Double-click a node (opens the label/value box)
Select "Node size" (enum of diagram.node.change.size; current px shown)
Hover a node: ports; drag from a port to a node or port
Drag a selected connection's end handle
Drag a middle handle or the line; drag a bend; double-click a bend; drag the label
Draft: "Numeric group label", select "Chart layout" (bar, line, pie, doughnut), textarea "Chart data" (label, number per line), "Create numeric group"
New: Link tools (route, reverse, insert node); arrowheads also back
Implicit document creation before any add
Button "+ Chapter" (then inline edit of the new heading)
Button "+ List" (dialog: one item per line)
Button "+ Table" (dialog: tab-separated cells, one row per line)
Drag a block handle onto another block (drop above or below its middle)
Alt+Up / Alt+Down on a focused block
Inline textarea: blur or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter saves; Escape cancels; text selection sets the range
Button "+ New event" (opens an empty form, 09:00-10:00 on the selected day)
Drag an event chip onto another day column
Arrow keys on a focused event chip (Left/Right ±1 day; Up/Down ±30 min, Shift ±15 min)
Form "Title", "Date", "End date", "Start time", "End time", "Notes (optional)", "Save" (end after start checked locally)
